subject: string linetype not working in geom_hline()

messages.author: 67d9969f93ac5614
messages.subject: string linetype not working in geom_hline()
parts:
Dear all,

The following works when linetype is specified as a number (linetype=2), but not when specified as a string (linetype='dashed'), as shown below. Hadley's ggplot2 mentions that linetype can be specified both as number or as string, so this seems to be a bug. If it is, what would be the best way to report it? If it is not, what did I miss?

Thanks for your help!

Adi


library(reshape)
library(ggplot2)

myDf = expand.grid(x=seq(1,3), y=0, gp=factor(c('A','B','C')), mean=0)
myDf$y = c(rnorm(3, mean=1), rnorm(3, mean=2), rnorm(3, mean=3))
myDf$mean = c(rep(1,3), rep(2,3), rep(3,3))

p = ggplot(myDf) + geom_point(aes(x=x,y=y)) + facet_wrap(~gp, scales='free', nrow=1)
p + geom_hline(aes(yintercept=mean, linetype='dashed'))

messages.subject: Re: string linetype not working in geom_hline()
parts:
It's not a bug - it's a misunderstanding of the difference between
setting an aesthetic to a fixed value or mapping it to a variable.
What you want is

p + geom_hline(aes(yintercept=mean), linetype='dashed')

mean varies between groups, so it needs to be mapped inside an aes()
statement. Linetype is fixed ('dashed'), so it is specified outside
aes(). See the examples and help pages cited in my preceding response
to see how this works, not just in geom_hline and geom_vline, but
other geoms as well. This is the first hurdle to overcome in
ggplot2...there are others, but it's worth the climb.

Dennis
